Overpriced. Disappointing.
Apr 2024 • Family
Very tempting from the outside. 
I ordered the lamb chops from the menu, where three chops are pictured each atop a decent scoop of mashed potatoes. 
They are charged at (as I remember) about 0.5m Dong each. For one chop. 
I ordered two. 
Much was made of the uncovering of the dish when it came - the stainless steel cover being lifted to reveal two lonely - modest sized chops - with one stick of carrot, and one ‘tree’ each of cauliflower and broccoli. 
It all was cooked fine (if a little too red for med-rare) and came with a boat of pepper sauce. 
But the total lack of mashed potato (as pictured in the menu) was a severe disappointment (yep - I probably need to get over it). 
Agree with earlier critiques of the salad bar. 
My son’s steak was gristley (sp?) - my wife says her’s was ‘acceptable’. 
Overall - a bit of a sour taste in the mouth, value-wise.

Disappointed experience. Food quality is way off
Jun 2022 • Friends
The menu look ok but the food is a let down
- A salad from menu: kinda decent (thought it is a great start)
- Taco: not very crunchy and then the wet sauce ruin the middle part
- Grill combo: 3 types of steak which in the menu are tenderloins but far from tender and under seasonning. Ordered medium. 1st piece got the right temperature, 2nd piece a bit under but still ok with me. 3rd piece, well i can only say it is as if you take it from a farm and tourch the outside for color, cold in the middle and odd smell. Called the server and she was kind enough to let chef know he screwed up 3 times. Of course 3rd time the charm, it is over cooked but dont know how the middle part is still not hot. (FYI. We eat this right when it is served)
- Pan seared salmon: ordered medium. Cut into it and it is mush, i am so afraid of having diarrhea to have the second bite.
Recommendation for dinners: with the price they charge, there are better restaurant to enjoy
Recommendation for the restaurant: change the cook and recheck the stock for spoiled item
